status: Empirical trajectory candidate for prospective diagnostics; not an accepted production constant.

vertical.qualification: Approximate curvature in displayed/native-frame domain. Does not establish hidden native fractional-force code or drawing/physical feet equivalence.
vertical.initialization: Same first source fish at the authenticated 2252/2256 prefixes uses this frozen anchor. For a new fish, initialize y to its first complete descriptor feet; infer initial vy from its first three consecutive available images only using the same fixed gravity; reserve all subsequent poses for prediction. Do not adjust a later pose or phase.
vertical.sampling: Continuous predicted positions compared against exact descriptor anchors; failures retained.

horizontal.qualification: First fish only. Later fish demonstrably differ. No single universal magnitude or direction selector is accepted.

activationHypothesis.qualification: First visible arcs extrapolate near initial approach to world x192. Birth may be offscreen; neither trigger nor latent timer is identified.
